nuggets.text: The Packers are owned by 538,967 stockholders, and the shares pay no dividends and cannot be traded.
Packers stock first went on sale in 1923, at $5 a share.
Matt LaFleur walked on at Western Michigan and later played indoor football for the Omaha Beef.
Matt LaFleur won more games through his first 40 than any head coach in NFL history.
Matt LaFleur's younger brother, Mike LaFleur, became head coach of the Arizona Cardinals in February.
The first Lambeau Leap came in 1993, when LeRoy Butler jumped into the stands after a score against the Raiders.
Jordan Love completed 20 straight passes against Pittsburgh last season, tying Brett Favre's Packers record.
Antonio Freeman's 2000 overtime catch against the Vikings, off his own shoulder, drew Al Michaels' call: 'He did what?'
Zaire Franklin, a seventh-round pick, led the NFL with 173 tackles in 2024 before the Packers traded for him.
The Packers lead their all-time series with the Vikings 67-61-3, dating to a 33-7 win in 1961.
